gloss: princely house; branch of the imperial family

definitions.gloss: princely house; branch of the imperial family
definitions.explanation: A branch family of the Japanese imperial house, headed by a prince and named with 〜{宮|みや} ({秋篠宮家|あきしののみやけ}, the Akishino house). The word comes up in news about the imperial family and its succession.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{宮家|みやけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new princely house was established.
The number of princely houses is decreasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皇族|こうぞく}→皇族：22657_kouzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、{宮家|みやけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{在|あ}り{方|かた}→在り方：10219_arikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: With the imperial family shrinking, the future of the princely houses is being debated.

notes:
A house is named after its title: {秋篠宮家|あきしののみやけ}, {常陸宮家|ひたちのみやけ}. The head of the house is called by the title alone, {秋篠宮|あきしののみや}さま.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宮家|みやけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{創設|そうせつ}→創設：11905_sousetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to establish a princely house
- {旧宮家|きゅうみやけ}: the former princely houses (removed from the imperial family in 1947)
- {宮家|みやけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{当主|とうしゅ}→当主：12765_toushu⟧: the head of a princely house
